channel.title: Tessa Turing | AI tips
channel.description: Plain-English AI help for real life

item.title: Turn that old family recipe card into one you can use
item.description: That handwritten recipe card everyone loves can become a clear, printable recipe in a few minutes Take a photo of the card and upload it to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Ask it to type the card up exactly, then update old measurements and scale it for your crowd.

item.title: 5 AI tools worth trying if you're a grandparent
item.description: Five AI tools that fit right into grandparent life Meta AI lives inside WhatsApp, so help is one chat away. Google Lens answers the endless what-is-that questions on walks.

item.title: Screenshot a sale before you tap Buy
item.description: Before you tap Buy this week, try one screenshot Take a screenshot of the deal and share it with ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Ask for the total cost with shipping, the return window and the small print.

item.title: That confusing letter? Snap a photo and ask
item.description: That letter you have read three times and still can't quite follow? Take a photo of it (cover your account and ID numbers first) and upload it to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Ask for a plain-English summary: what it is about, what you need to do, and any deadlines.

item.title: Don't know what to ask AI? Let it ask you
item.description: Staring at the AI chat box with no idea what to type? Try this: tell it what you need help with, then ask it to ask YOU a few questions first. It asks one question at a time, and you can tap the microphone and answer out loud.

item.title: Behind on the family group chat? Try this
item.description: Opened the family group chat and found a wall of messages? Take a few screenshots of what you missed and upload them to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Ask for a plain-English catch-up: what was decided, what is still open, and anything asked of you.

item.title: Holiday week coming up and the to-do list didn't get the memo?
item.description: Holiday week coming up and the to-do list didn't get the memo? Three prompts to plan it: 1. Triage: what must happen before the break, what can wait, what can go

item.title: Guests coming soon and the house is a mess?
item.description: Guests coming soon and the house is a mess? These 3 prompts give you a timed cleaning plan for the rooms people actually see. Prompt 2 clears the piles in 15 minutes with a simple basket system.

item.title: 5 AI tools that fit the stay-at-home parent day
item.description: 5 AI tools that fit the stay-at-home parent day Gemini helps with the school emails right in Gmail. NotebookLM answers questions from the handbook and schedule PDFs you upload.

item.title: That small monthly charge you forgot about? It has friends
item.description: That small monthly charge you forgot about? It has friends. Copy last month's transactions, remove your account and card numbers, and paste them into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Prompt 1 lists every repeat charge with a yearly total.

item.title: Does your AI draft sound like a corporate brochure?
item.description: Does your AI draft sound like a corporate brochure? Three prompts make it sound like you. 1. Paste a few things you wrote and get a short style guide of your voice.

item.title: That one task that has been on your list since September? Let's move it
item.description: That one task that has been on your list since September? Let's move it. Big vague tasks are hard to start because there's no clear first step. Prompt 1 breaks it into 10-minute pieces.

item.title: That email you sent last week and never heard back on? Let's deal with it
item.description: That email you sent last week and never heard back on? Let's deal with it Three prompts, three follow-ups: a gentle nudge, a clear next step, and a polite last call. Paste in your original email, fill in the brackets, and you have a reply-ready message in under a minute.

item.title: Sunday reset, done in about 15 minutes
item.description: Sunday reset, done in about 15 minutes One chat, three prompts, pasted in order. First a quick look back at last week, then a sort of everything rattling around your head.

item.title: Hosting this year? Let AI handle the planning so you can focus on the food
item.description: Hosting this year? Let AI handle the planning so you can focus on the food. Three prompts, one chat: 1. A menu that fits your guests and your oven

item.title: Reading about something is not the same as learning it
item.description: Reading about something is not the same as learning it. This 3-prompt loop turns any free AI chat into a patient tutor. Step 1: get a plain-English explanation with an analogy.
